requirements_summary: Workload: document search for 100k+ active users; nightly batch ingestion of ~2M docs; real-time embeddings for updates.
Throughput targets: sustained batch ingest 30k-60k docs/hr; peak parallel embed throughput 2000 qps for live app during business hours.
Latency targets: median search (embed + vector nearest-neighbors + re-rank) <150ms for top-5; tail <400ms.
Vector DB needs: native connectors to Pinecone + option for self-hosted Milvus; testing for consistency and cold-start behavior.
Batch job expectations: retry semantics, idempotency, checkpointing; ability to resume after preemption.
Model preferences: open embeddings preferred (cost-driven) but flexibility to test Redwood-verified models; quantized variants acceptable.
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback from Dedicated to Hosted API with SLA-aware throttling and alerting.
Security/compliance: SOC2 Type II cert required; SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning; KMS integration for key control; audit logs retention 1 year.
Operational: per-route cost telemetry, token-level billing visibility, and per-batch job tracing required for capacity planning.
